title: After the Hanshin J.F.: Behind the Pillar

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gossip concerning Sweep Tosho's bratty behavior spreads among the racecourse staff, who worry that she won't show up for the winning concert.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But I tell them she'll be fine. Hearing that, Sweep Tosho shows up to the concert on time and performs spectacularly.
